artworks.title: Madame Arlon Spinning Silk
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 39 × 26.5 cm (15 3/8 × 10 7/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a chair, facing forward with a calm expression. She has soft features, arched eyebrows, and styled hair with a hat. She wears a dress with ruffled sleeves and a scarf. The woman holds a spinning wheel, operating it gently. The background is a dark patterned canvas with text below the image.

artworks.title: An Arab Rider on Camelback
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in profile, body slightly turned towards the viewer. The upper three-quarters of the body is depicted, with one arm raised slightly. The person's face is obscured by a hood, and the head is covered by fabric of a large cloak or robe. The person wears layered, draped clothing with intricate details. The drawing is against a blue-toned background, with no visible jewelry or objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Traveler Resting
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a figure under trees in the foreground. In the mid-distance, there is a large building on a hill. The engraving is detailed with precise linework depicting foliage, rocks, and water. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow. Hills, trees, and clouds are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: L'Orido a Bellano sul Lago di Como (The Orrido di Bellano near Lake Como)
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with brown wash on wove paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky gorge with a bridge crossing from one ledge to another. The viewer is looking down on the bridge extending horizontally across the canyon. The scene is filled with towering rock formations, dense foliage, and a distant stone arch. The painting technique highlights the textures of rocks, trees, and water with detailed brushwork. The color scheme is monochromatic with warm sepia tones. Near the viewer, there are plants and boards by the river's edge.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy of Roman Ruins with an Inscription Plaque
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows classical columns to the left, with trees in the background. The brushstrokes create texture and depth in the greenery and architecture. The color palette consists of muted browns, grays, and greens. Plants and gourds are at the base of the columns. Vine-like plants climb the structure. A figure is leaning over a basin of water or fountain towards the right side.

artworks.title: Chrysanthemums
artworks.medium: black chalk and charcoal heightened with white chalk on gray laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image features a group of large chrysanthemum flowers with swirling petals. The color palette is grayscale with shades of white and hints of bluish highlights against a beige background. The flowers are positioned centrally with some higher and others lower, giving a sense of depth. Stems and leaves are also present, framing the arrangement of the blooms.

artworks.title: The Hayloft
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache and scratching out on wove paper, laid down on board
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior barn scene with sunlight streaming through an open window. The painting depicts a rustic, earthy setting with a wooden shutter partially closed on one side. On the floor, there's a woven basket and scattered hay. The light coming through the window illuminates the scene with a warm glow, casting soft shadows around. This is in the style of George John Pinwell, known for detailed renderings of everyday scenes.

artworks.title: Schweiz, Kanton Wallis, Rhonegletscher (Switzerland, Canton of Valais, Rhône Glacier)
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with a glacier. The glacier spans the scene, separating the rugged peaks in the background from the rocky slopes in the foreground. The snow-capped peaks create a silhouette against the sky. The black and white photograph accentuates the textures and contrasts between the snow and rocks. The image conveys the grandeur and isolation of the alpine environment, emphasizing the scale and majesty of the landscape.

artworks.title: Scene on St. Helier, Jersey Parish
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a castle with cylindrical towers at the center and slightly left. The castle has battlements with a flag on top. Close to the castle are sailing ships with tall masts grounded due to low tide. More ships line the shore to the right. The castle is made of stone. The color scheme is sepia, giving an antique look. The sky is light and overcast, blending with distant hills. A rocky bank leads to the water where a lone figure is visible.

artworks.title: Design for a Trompe-l'oeil Ceiling Decoration
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the ornate ceiling of a grand architectural structure. The full-description shows a dramatic ceiling view, dominated by rows of vertical columns. Each column is intricately detailed, showcasing a classical architectural style, complete with decorative capitals and bases. Central to this composition, there is a rectangular inset featuring faint sketches of figures. The detailed cornices and moldings add further elegance, creating a sense of depth. The use of shading and perspective gives this drawing a vivid three-dimensional effect, illustrating the artist's mastery in architectural rendering.

artworks.title: Interior of a Cross-Vaulted Hall Decorated with Grotesques
artworks.artist: Lucas van Doetechum and Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder, after Hans Vredeman de Vries
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with statues. The image shows a long corridor with high arched ceilings, columns, and walls adorned with sculptures and reliefs of classical figures. The ceiling is decorated with patterns and ornaments, and the floor has a patterned tile. Windows on the sides offer a glimpse of the outside.

artworks.title: Open Hall Supported by Corinthian Columns
artworks.artist: Lucas van Doetechum and Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder, after Hans Vredeman de Vries
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure with an arched colonnade. The image depicts a detailed illustration of a classical architectural setting, featuring a long corridor bordered by tall columns supporting an adorned entablature. Light appears at the end of the corridor, indicating depth and perspective. On the right side, there is an arched entrance with intricate detailing, including a sculpted figure above the pediment. The artwork emphasizes texture and depth through delicate hatching and strong linework on the stone-like surfaces to convey grandeur and architectural precision.

artworks.title: Open Hall Supported by Tuscan Columns with a Town Square on the Right
artworks.artist: Lucas van Doetechum and Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder, after Hans Vredeman de Vries
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene. The image features a series of intricately designed arches supported by columns. The arches are decorated with geometric patterns and stylized lion heads at the peaks of each arch. The drawing demonstrates fine detail and precision, typical of architectural drafting, with a linear perspective that conveys depth and grandeur.

artworks.title: Gladiolus ringens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a tall plant with light purple flowers blooming from the top right. The stem and leaves are depicted in soft greens, while the flowers have shades of blue and hints of yellow in their petals. Additionally, there are pencil sketches of the plant parts, including a detailed view of the flower and dissected reproductive structures, at the bottom left.

artworks.title: Narcissus calathinus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a snowdrop plant. It includes a bulb, green leaves, and white bell-shaped flowers. The color scheme consists of soft greens, whites, and earthy tones. The main plant is centered vertically with detailed sketches of its parts scattered at the bottom in pencil.

artworks.title: Iris Swertii
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: The image displays a botanical illustration of an iris plant. The drawing shows the tall plant with white petals and purple accents, along with green stem and leaves. The iris is positioned centrally, with its leaves extending outward. A pencil sketch of a segment of the iris and a partial flower is included towards the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Diasia iridifolia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a flowering plant with elongated green leaves and a slender, arching stem bearing several small flowers. The flowers are white with hints of pink and yellow at the tips. The color palette includes shades of green, pink, and white. The plant is centered with its bulb and roots visible at the bottom. The flowers are distributed along the stem, reaching towards the upper-right corner. Small sketches of flower parts and petals are drawn faintly to the right of the plant.

artworks.title: Iris curtopetala
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with long green leaves and a yellow flower located at the top center. The color scheme includes shades of green and yellow, with neutral tones in the background. The plant is in the center with its leaves spread outward, and there are detailed sketches of the plant's parts at the base in gray.

artworks.title: Sowerbaea juncea
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: The image features a botanical illustration of a plant with long, slender green stems and clusters of small lavender and purple flowers at their tips. The color palette consists mainly of shades of green, lavender, purple, and brown, with some muted background tones. In the center of the image, the plant's roots extend downward, while five flowering stems fan out from various angles in the upper half. To the left, a single stem is depicted without a flower, and to the right are small sketches of the plant's parts. The background is a neutral off-white.

artworks.title: Tradescantia virginica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: A tall, slender green stem with elongated leaves and a cluster of vibrant purple flowers is featured in the image. The color palette is mainly green with touches of purple in the flowers and small hints of yellow in the flower centers. The stem stands vertically in the middle of the composition, with long leaves splaying out to both sides and flowers near the top section of the stem.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls
artworks.creditLine: Robinson Family Fund in memory of C. David Robinson and Clinton and Jean Wright Fund
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white photograph with a circular frame showing a group of people standing on a ledge by a large waterfall. The perspective is from behind the individuals, as they face the waterfall. Mist rises from the water, obscuring the horizon. The people are dressed in period attire and are silhouetted against the water. Vegetation is on the right, and trees line the distant riverbank.

artworks.title: Nude with Jewelry
artworks.creditLine: Gift (Partial and Promised) of Trina and Lee G. Rubenstein
artworks.description: This is a stylized woodcut print featuring a person standing with a hand raised to their face in a thoughtful pose. The person's facial features are abstracted but suggest eyes, a nose, and a mouth, and their hair or head covering is stylized. The clothing is loosely fitted with patterned folds, and there are swirling, abstract patterns around the figure resembling foliage. The background features high-contrast, jagged lines and patterns for added texture.

artworks.title: A Salver with Two Bases
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper, laid down on an album sheet
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate decorative stand or platter with intricate floral and leaf patterns along its edges. In the center, there is a heraldic shield or crest motif. The base has a curving stand with detailed styling similar to the rest of the design. The drawing uses a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: A Salver and an Openwork Base
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk and graphite on laid paper, laid down on an album sheet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative tabletop standing on two ornate bases. The tabletop is oval with intricate detailing around the edges and features a central crest or coat of arms with floral and leaf motifs. Below are two pedestal bases with ornamental detailing. The drawing is in a sepia tone, giving it an aged appearance.
